metadata.description: Training-only evidence for a fictional organisation.
metadata.provenance: Locally authored synthetic workshop data; no real persons, systems, or accounts.

events.event_description: Unexpected request to review a shared document from an unfamiliar external sender.
events.observed_behaviour: A document-review link was received; delivery and receipt are observed.
events.potential_significance: Could be routine unsolicited mail or social engineering; no click is established.
events.evidence_limitations: No link-click, message-authentication, or sender-verification record.

events.event_description: Successful sign-in from an unfamiliar location: 198.51.100.42, geolocation shown as Example City.
events.observed_behaviour: Authentication succeeded from an IP not in the user's recent baseline.
events.potential_significance: May warrant validation with the employee; unfamiliarity does not prove account compromise.
events.evidence_limitations: No device fingerprint, MFA detail, travel context, or impossible-travel calculation.

events.event_description: WINWORD.EXE launched a PowerShell process with a short encoded-looking argument.
events.observed_behaviour: An office application spawned a scripting interpreter.
events.potential_significance: Potential command and scripting interpreter activity; the argument was not executed by this lab.
events.evidence_limitations: Parent-child telemetry lacks full command line, signer, and file provenance.

events.event_description: A process queried running processes and installed security products.
events.observed_behaviour: Process and security-tool inventory queries were recorded.
events.potential_significance: Consistent with discovery, but inventory software and troubleshooting can produce similar events.
events.evidence_limitations: Querying process, user, and process ancestry details are incomplete.

events.event_description: The account opened Q4-Merger, Payroll-Controls, and Board-Notes documents outside its usual working pattern.
events.potential_significance: Could indicate inappropriate access or legitimate work; content transfer is not shown.
events.evidence_limitations: No document sensitivity labels, business justification, or read-versus-download distinction.

events.event_description: Outbound transfer alert for 18.4 MB to 203.0.113.77 over HTTPS.
events.observed_behaviour: A volume anomaly was detected; destination is documentation-only TEST-NET-3.
events.potential_significance: May be normal synchronisation or possible data transfer requiring content and destination validation.
events.evidence_limitations: No packet content, TLS metadata, destination ownership, or file manifest.

events.event_description: The mail client marked the message as unread; no click event is present in the synthetic record.
events.observed_behaviour: Receipt is followed by no recorded interaction before the sign-in.
events.potential_significance: Provides an alternative timeline to the hypothesis that the message caused later activity.
events.evidence_limitations: Telemetry may be incomplete and does not prove the link was not opened elsewhere.

events.event_description: A signed document-management updater ran for 42 seconds during the same window.
events.observed_behaviour: A benign software update process overlapped with the scripting event.
events.potential_significance: Could explain some process and network activity independently.
events.evidence_limitations: Hash and network destination are not included.

events.event_description: A calendar entry shows an approved merger-workstream meeting scheduled for the employee.
events.observed_behaviour: The employee had a plausible business reason to view at least one unusual document.
events.potential_significance: Weakens an automatic conclusion that all file access was malicious.
events.evidence_limitations: Meeting attendance and manager approval are not independently verified.

events.event_description: The transfer alert closed after a scheduled cloud-sync policy check.
events.observed_behaviour: A policy check overlapped the alert close time.
events.potential_significance: An alternative explanation for the outbound volume; file-level attribution remains unresolved.
events.evidence_limitations: No sync job ID or transferred-object manifest is available.
